activity.notes: Existing verified Person Ulugh Beg (historical UUID 1137412e-532c-472c-a5ec-e32d9e530499) currently lacks a public chronological Activity. Stanford archive explains that his father Shah Rukh granted him the Transoxiana province around 1409; his provincial authority should not be treated as sovereign rule of the entire Timurid Empire. Shah Rukh died in 1447, when Ulugh Beg began a distinct attempted empire-wide succession. The 1447 provincial term boundary is year-only and approximately delimited; distinguish the separate 1447-1449 succession Activity. Reuse canonical existing Timurid Empire Polity UUID, never create a parallel Timurid province as a fabricated independent kingdom.

sources.title: Stanford University — Practical Astronomy in the Islamicate World: Ulugh Beg's Zij-i Sultani
sources.citation_text: Stanford digital critical edition's introduction reports that Shah Rukh granted the province of Mawarannahr/Transoxiana to young Ulugh Beg around 1409, and his father's death in 1447 began his attempted imperial succession.

sources.title: UNESCO Portal to the Heritage of Astronomy — Ulugh Beg Observatory
sources.citation_text: UNESCO heritage astronomy portal describes Ulugh Beg as ruler of Transoxiana from 1409 to 1449 and describes his 1420 educational and 1424 astronomical institutions.

spatial_disposition.evidence: Ulugh Beg's Timurid provincial administration is source-linked to Transoxiana/Samarkand, but exact canonical Place and time-bounded function UUIDs were not reviewed. No invented point geometry.
